{{Top|leg}}
The '''Tekrans''' were a group who stole a [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ship]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Tekrans maintained [[Tekra Point]] as a base for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and also maintained a [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]].
